Release notes:

- Revised documentation and extended demo notebook.
- Make fields case insensitive in generic query syntax.
- Revise linter message formatting and internal handling; `WOS_0005` deprecated.
- Extend `QueryErrorCode.JOURNAL_FILTER_IN_SUBQUERY` with ISSN and ISBN.
- Remove packaging dependency.
